question: What is the difference between depreciation and amortization?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-D with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-D professionals.
exampleAnswer: Depreciation is for tangible assets (equipment, buildings); amortization is for intangible assets (patents, software). Both spread cost over useful life. In my project, I calculated depreciation for machinery using straight-line method and amortized software licenses over 3 years.
